meta.description: DTC infrastructure standards for network assessment gap analysis

dns.standard: UDM gateway IP as sole DNS server on all endpoints
dns.gap_condition: Any DNS server configured that is not the default gateway or 127.0.0.1
dns.sow_item: DNS reconfiguration — set UDM as sole DNS

rmm.standard: NinjaOne agent installed and checking in
rmm.sow_item: RMM deployment — install NinjaOne, remove competing agents

backup.note: Existing backup software documented for reference. DTC deploys Veeam BDR during onboarding regardless of current solution.

antivirus.sow_item: AV cleanup — remove consumer AV, deploy managed protection

domain.sow_item: Domain deployment — build AD domain, join all endpoints

local_admin.standard: DTCADMIN local admin account with LAPS via NinjaRMM
local_admin.sow_item: Local admin standardization — create DTCADMIN, deploy LAPS

printers.standard: Centralized via Print Server + GPO deployment
printers.gap_condition: Direct IP printer connections on workstations
printers.sow_item: Printer centralization — configure print server, deploy via GPO

disk_health.sow_item: Disk remediation — cleanup or drive replacement

stale_accounts.sow_item: AD cleanup — disable stale accounts, audit group memberships

domain_admins.sow_item: Privilege audit — reduce Domain Admins membership
